authoritative_disposition_record.title: Authoritative disposition record
x-cross-field-constraints: each raw has one linear sequence starting at 0
every non-initial record references the immediately prior disposition_id
fork, duplicate sequence, missing parent, invalid transition, or multiple heads fail closed

current86_a2_execution_manifest.title: Current86 A2 P0 execution manifest
x-cross-field-constraints: execution_manifest_id is omitted only for identity calculation; generated manifest carries its self-ID

escalation_terminal.title: A2 escalation terminal R2
x-cross-field-constraints: selected owner is null
unresolved_state is true
pre-human escalation has null human fields
human escalation has NOT_SURE plus provenance

final_freeze_normative_manifest.title: P4 normative final-freeze manifest schema
x-cross-field-constraints: No CURRENT86_A2_FINAL_FREEZE_ID is materialized in this contract-only turn
workload telemetry cannot be an identity input

final_freeze_package_manifest.title: P4 package manifest schema
x-cross-field-constraints: Package identity may include workload files while normative identity excludes them

human_decision_record.title: Native raw-level human decision record R2

owner_terminal.title: A2 owner terminal R2
x-cross-field-constraints: owner human_action is CONFIRM or REJECT_SELECT only
REJECT_SELECT requires fresh alternative verification PASS

pending_terminal_invalidated.title: PENDING_TERMINAL_INVALIDATED disposition
x-cross-field-constraints: prior_state=PENDING_REVIEW
next_state=BLOCKED_ATTEMPT
pending terminal remains historical and stale for current pending membership

primary_commitment.title: Primary A2 commitment
x-cross-field-constraints: UNIQUE_EXISTING_OWNER_PROPOSAL requires both selected IDs non-null; every escalation status requires both null
private chain-of-thought is prohibited

remediation_restarted.title: REMEDIATION_RESTARTED disposition
x-cross-field-constraints: prior_state=BLOCKED_ATTEMPT
next_state=IN_PROGRESS_OR_INCOMPLETE

terminal_accepted.title: TERMINAL_ACCEPTED disposition
x-cross-field-constraints: prior_state=PENDING_REVIEW
next_state=ACCEPTED_TERMINAL
accepted terminal supersedes historical blocked/pending/incomplete rows

verifier_commitment.title: Verifier A2 commitment
x-cross-field-constraints: Verifier commitment is frozen after an isolated derivation with no primary result context
